geopolitics_summary: Iran–US conflict escalates; Strait of Hormuz supply risk elevated. Russia fuel export cuts post-Ukraine strikes. EU green policy under political pressure ahead of votes.

themes.headline: Iran–US war, Strait of Hormuz control unresolved, no swift end
themes.why_it_matters: Hormuz blockade or disruption cuts Middle East LNG & oil exports to NW Europe. Tightens global LNG arb, pushes TTF higher via reduced supply and higher Brent. Direct EU gas price transmission.

themes.headline: France nuclear shut-downs amid extreme heat surge demand-side tension
themes.why_it_matters: Heat-driven nuclear availability loss in France (EU's largest baseload) forces substitute gas/coal generation. Tightens DA spreads, lifts power prices. Cooling water scarcity is recurring summer risk for Central Europe.

themes.headline: Russia halts diesel exports after Ukraine refinery strikes
themes.why_it_matters: Russian fuel export halt signals energy infrastructure vulnerability. Indirect EU power impact via fuel input costs and potential coal-to-gas switching if diesel supply tightens. Monitor for spillover into power generation fuel sourcing.

themes.headline: Global LNG trade volumes hit record 56.3 Bcf/d in 2025
themes.why_it_matters: Expanding global LNG supply (US capacity growth) increases optionality for EU LNG buyers. Supports TTF floor via incremental arbitrage volumes. Offsets some Strait of Hormuz risk. Positive for medium-term gas availability.

themes.headline: EU sanctions package on Russia oil price cap hits Wednesday deadline
themes.why_it_matters: Sanctions/price cap outcomes drive Brent floor and EU refined product (gasoil) input costs. Indirectly affects power plant fuel switching economics and heating demand outlook. Policy uncertainty creates near-term volatility.

watchlist: EU green rules vote (Sweden, Italy positions clashing); outcome affects EUA carbon-intensive power incentives.
Strait of Hormuz military/diplomatic escalation; monitor LNG shipping delays and premium risk.
France nuclear plant restart schedule as cooling conditions improve; baseload supply signal for DA power curve.
Russia sanctions package finalisation by July 16; oil price cap changes ripple into EU fuel cost inflation.
